notes:
## Komos Regulated Browser Ops Task Queue

Use this template to queue a Komos task from n8n when a CRA, bank, or insurance ops workflow needs browser portal work.

Set these environment variables before running:

KOMOS_API_KEY
KOMOS_TASK_ID

API docs: https://docs.komos.ai/api-reference/introduction
Background screening example: https://www.komos.ai/solutions/hr
